text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Groove, about the tea you shared with
me
yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is it? Did it not suit your tastes?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, quite the opposite! I was wondering
if you
could tell me the brand so I can
buy some more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you enjoyed it, but
unfortunately it is not
something you can
purchase. That tea was made
with
chamomile flowers I grew myself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yourself?! Oh my, I received quite the
valuable
gift.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then may I ask for some more to
send to
my family? They love all kinds of
tea!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
N-now wait just a moment! I'm afraid I
can't allow
you to do that!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your family's thank-you gifts always
completely
fill up my room. I end up
with no place to sleep!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes, I can see that. They do tend to
go a bit
overboard expressing their
gratitude.
